sourceVersion: Poway USD 2025-2026 Student Calendar, BOE Approved 11/14/24; Revised 06/17/25
heroSummary: Poway Unified's 180-day calendar includes four named District Recesses: Thanksgiving, Winter, Mid-Winter, and Spring. High school students have an additional non-student day on November 17 that does not apply districtwide.
seoTitle: Poway USD Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Poway USD Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, holidays, district recesses, non-student days, Spring Break, PDF, ICS download, and key family planning dates.
calendarNotes: Poway USD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 13, 2025 and ends on June 4, 2026. The student calendar includes 180 student days, Thanksgiving District Recess from November 24-28, Winter District Recess from December 22-January 2, Mid-Winter District Recess from February 16-20, and Spring District Recess from April 6-10. The calendar also lists non-student days, professional growth days for staff, and major holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Poway USD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Poway USD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring District Recess runs Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Poway USD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 4, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Poway USD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The regular Poway USD 2025-2026 student calendar has 180 student days based on the listed first day, last day, holidays, recesses, and non-student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Poway USD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter District Recess runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Poway USD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Poway USD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: Poway USD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The Poway USD 2025-2026 student calendar provides districtwide student dates for family planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student holidays, non-student days, professional growth days for staff, Thanksgiving District Recess, Winter District Recess, Mid-Winter District Recess, Spring District Recess, and the last day of school.

customSections.label: How We Verify Poway USD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Poway USD calendars page and published student calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, district recesses, holidays, non-student days, and professional growth days for staff, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Poway USD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
